rows.grounds: past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: In what vast array of womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from prior context rather than stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
